{{Nihongo|'''Akame'''|アカメ|Akame}}, also known as '''Akame of the Demon Sword Murasame''', is the titular heroine of ''[[Akame ga Kill! (Series)|Akame ga Kill!]]''. She was sold to [[the Empire]] along with her sister [[Kurome]] and joined [[Night Raid]].

==Appearance==
Akame is an attractive young woman of slim build with red eyes and long black hair that reaches her knees. She wears a dark sleeveless top with a red tie.

==Personality==
She appears serious and cold-hearted, which stems from her training, but is actually socially awkward. She cares deeply about her comrades and loves to eat meat.

==History==
When Akame was a child, her parents sold her and [[Kurome]] to the Empire. She was trained as an assassin in the [[Elite Seven]] before defecting to the [[Revolutionary Army]].

==Equipment==
She wields the [[Teigu]] [[Murasame]], and later uses [[Rongo Rongo]].

==Trivia==
* Akame's measurements are 81-56-83.
* She is voiced by [[Sora Amamiya]].
